subject: Exception requests: retention, BYOK & SSO compatibility
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@nimbushealth.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: eric.lowe@nimbushealth.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Retention & BYOK: follow-up + questionnaire

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was encouraged by the latency numbers. We have a handful of compliance follow-ups before Legal will recommend any pilot: primarily (1) a short mapping of audit log retention options for hosted vs dedicated, (2) whether we can do BYOK with our Keys-in-HSM requirement, and (3) confirmation SSO (SAML) will not change token retention for activity logs.

I attached our security questionnaire (Nimbus_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf) — the security team flagged a few “exceptions” items where they expect alternative controls rather than the standard 90d retention. Can someone from your security or product team confirm what exceptions we can support and what the operational impact will be (e.g., additional costs, evidence pages)?

High-level asks:
- Can audit logs be configured per-tenant retention (30/90/365 days)?
- Can we support BYOK with a customer HSM (KMS-backed keys) in a private deployment? Any limitations?
- Does SSO metadata (SAML assertions) get persisted in logs beyond the standard retention?

We’re hoping to get answers by end of week so Nimbus Legal can draft a pilot-specific provision.

Best,
Nina

Attachments: Nimbus_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf (pdf, 312 KB)

Subject: Re: Retention & BYOK: follow-up + questionnaire

Thanks for the context. Quick triage below — high level first, then notes against the customer questionnaire (I attached short pointers inline).

High-level answers:
- Audit log retention: Hosted API: default 90d, configurable to 30/90. 365-day retention requires Dedicated or Private and an ops-level SLA (storage + indexing cost spike). We can support per-tenant retention on Dedicated and Private.
- BYOK/HSM: Full BYOK with customer-managed keys supported only in Private deployments with KMS/HSM integration (FIPS 140-2/3), but note: we do not persist plaintext model caches or tokens encrypted under customer keys by default — operational changes needed. There is an engineering delta: ~4-6 weeks to validate HSM certificate rotation hooks and key-wrapping flow in our installer for Private on-prem.
- SSO metadata: SAML assertions are recorded in audit logs as metadata (timestamp, principal, assertion id). Those metadata fields are part of the same retention policy as other logs. We do not, by default, persist full SAML payloads beyond diagnostic capture unless a) debug mode is enabled or b) customer requests extended retention for audit.

Questionnaire notes (selected):
- Q12 (log segmentation): confirm — Dedicated stores per-tenant logs in separate indices; Hosted stores in a multi-tenant index with RBAC controls.
- Q17 (PII redaction): we can apply structured redaction rules at ingestion (recommended). Will need to confirm which fields Nimbus flags as PII.
- Exceptions: we can entertain a contract-level exception for 30d->14d or 90d->14d with compensating controls (shorter retention + access monitoring + quarterly export to customer-controlled archive).

Action items:
- Karthik: collect Nimbus list of PII fields and confirm which logs they want shorter retention for.
- Marcus: please provide a ballpark timeline/impact for the BYOK hooks and incremental cost for 365d retention on Dedicated.
- Laura: if you can propose language for the exception (controls bundle) I’ll reference it in the customer reply.

Mina

Mina Haddad

From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention & BYOK: follow-up + questionnaire

Thanks — quick engineering read:
- BYOK/HSM: confirm we support customer KMS wrapping; work required on installer and rotation hooks (estimate 4-6 weeks for Private on-prem; 6-8 weeks if Nimbus requests FIPS-level attestation and custom HSM vendor testing). Cost: one-time engineering validation + an ongoing support add-on.
- 365d retention on Dedicated: we can do this but estimate +35-45% storage/indexing cost and a small latency impact on some analytics queries; recommend starting with a cold archive tier for >90d to minimize impact.
- SSO: no extra engineering work required unless Nimbus wants full SAML payload capture at ingestion — that is a feature flag with compliance review and additional storage.

I’ll open a short RFC and include a mount plan for the HSM key-wrapping (linking to SEC-482). If Nimbus wants to proceed with a pilot for Private + BYOK, we should schedule a technical scoping call next week.

Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Engineering | Redwood Inference
